subject: Private hosting: next steps & architecture deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novahealth.com>, Tom Bartlett <tom.bartlett@novainsights.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Aug 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Private hosting: next steps & architecture deep-dive scheduling

Hi Elena / Tom — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps so we can line up the architecture deep dive for a Private/VPC deployment:

- High-level recap: Nova Health is interested in a private deployment to meet PHI controls and regional isolation. Primary goals are predictable latency (<=120ms p95 for inference), data residency in us-east-1, and PKI integration for mutual TLS.
- Open items we promised to follow up on: expected QPS/RPS, model family & max sequence length, and details about existing VPN/bastion setup.

Proposed next step: 90-minute architecture deep dive (technical workshop) where our Solutions team walks your infra and security leads through network prerequisites, cert handling, and the deployment runbook. Proposed windows (PT):
  • Tue Aug 22, 14:00–15:30 PT
  • Wed Aug 23, 09:00–10:30 PT

Please confirm which window works (or propose an alternate time). Attendees we plan to include from Redwood: Marissa (Eng Manager, Private Deploys), Mina (SE, infra lead), and myself. If you have an internal network/PKI contact, please loop them in — we typically ask an infra/ops person and a security contact.

I attached a short "network prerequisites" template and our Private Deploy checklist to help prepare. Also linking our shared runbook here: https://redwood.app/drive/priv-deploy-runbook

Pre-call asks (short):
- VPN / bastion IP ranges allowed outbound (or let us know if you prefer a site-to-site demo)
- Does Nova Health require HSM/KMS integration for keys?
- Approx expected RPS and model size (parameters or model name)

Thanks — once you pick a time I will send a calendar invite with agenda and a dial-in.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: network-prereqs-template.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-priv-deploy-checklist.pdf (guide)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Bartlett <tom.bartlett@novainsights.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Aug 2028 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private hosting: next steps & architecture deep-dive scheduling

Marcus — thanks for the summary. Tue Aug 22, 14:00–15:30 PT works for our team. I will invite Aisha Bhatia (Network Lead) and our Security Architect (I've looped Tom for confirmation). A couple of quick clarifying items before the deep dive:

- We do require KMS-backed key material but are open to a hybrid approach; would like to discuss HSM options during the call.
- For VPN: we currently use a site-to-site tunnel and have an on-prem bastion for outbound egress. If your checklist calls for IP allowlists we can provide those ahead of time.
- Expected load initially ~50 RPS with occasional spikes to 120 RPS; model will likely be a 7B open model to start.

Please share the runbook and any pre-call network items we should complete.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ruiz
Director of Platform Engineering, Nova Health
Elena.Ruiz@novahealth.com

I've attached a "network-prereqs-template.xlsx" with the fields we'll need for allowlist/IPs and VPN details; filling that out ahead of the call will speed up the post-call runbook.

Agenda (90m):
  1) 15m — introductions + objectives
  2) 35m — network, PKI, and VPC connectivity patterns (Mina)
  3) 20m — deployment topology & HA considerations (Marissa)
  4) 15m — runbook, next steps, open Qs

Pre-call asks (short):
- Completed network-prereqs-template.xlsx (attached)
- Confirm whether you prefer an internal IP allowlist or temporary site-to-site preview
- Any compliance controls we should be aware of (DLP tools, deep packet inspection)

I will send the calendar invite to lock the time and include a Zoom link and shared drive items. If there are any other stakeholders (PKI team, SOC), please let us know and we'll expand the invite.

— Marissa

Elena / Tom / Aisha — thanks, calendar invite sent for Tue Aug 22 14:00–15:30 PT (Linked meeting + dial-in). I've attached the short Private Deploy checklist (redwood-priv-deploy-checklist.pdf) and included a proposed technical runbook link: https://redwood.app/drive/priv-deploy-runbook

Quick preparatory notes for the workshop:
- Please populate the network-prereqs-template.xlsx and share the file at least 24h before the call.
- If you can provide the allowed outbound IP ranges (or whether you prefer we test from a temporary tunnel), include them in the spreadsheet.
- Confirm whether keys will be managed in your KMS or if you'd like Redwood to manage a customer-specific key in our KMS (we'll discuss HSM options on the call).
- Helpful to have an example payload size and typical sequence length for your inference requests.

Proposed short agenda (copied):
  1) Introductions & success criteria
  2) Network & PKI patterns (bastion/site-to-site, NAT, allowlists)
  3) Deployment topology (replica counts, autoscaling, caching)
  4) Runbook & next-step checklist

If anything changes, ping me directly. Looking forward to it.

— Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-priv-deploy-checklist.pdf
